the nicest person in
{04 11 00}! Thank you

I'm leaving. I know this is
a surprise. Please forgive
me... I just need to see

the world! Everyone in

or tired or...anything!
So I'm moving! See ya!

I'm moving, but don't
worry! Tortimer told me
we're all on the same
planet, so I'll be OK!
